§ 01 · The Program

A complete
portfolio.

From foundational B1 nonprofit vocabulary to advanced C1 governance and development discourse, every module is anchored in real-world nonprofit scenarios — from grant writing to donor stewardship, from volunteer management to social impact measurement. Built for use inside NGOs, foundations, charities, and social enterprises.

01

Industry-anchored

Every question reflects real terminology from grant proposals, board meetings, and community programs in 2026.

02

AI & impact

AI-powered donor insights, digital fundraising, and predictive impact measurement run throughout the program — reflecting today's nonprofit sector.

03

Auto-graded

Instant scoring with executive-level performance feedback and improvement guidance after every exercise.

04

Case-led pedagogy

Mini case studies bring real nonprofit dilemmas — funding gaps, volunteer turnover, mission drift — into language learning.

§ 03 · The Author

Brice Gadou

Business English Expert

Brice Gadou is a Business English specialist dedicated to building world-class language training for international professionals. ONG reflects his vision: language learning as mission capability — a multiplier of careers, causes, and impact.

Designed for the executive directors, program managers, and development leaders shaping global social impact — ONG is more than vocabulary. It's the fluency to serve in one of the most meaningful sectors of our time.
